description: Get organization dashboard metrics including utilization, revenue, and active projects. utilizationOnClockHours is true when the utilization figures count clock hours (entries logged in parallel share the clock) rather than logged hours - say 'on clock hours' when it is true; logged-hour totals stay on logged hours either way.

month.description: Month to get metrics for in YYYY-MM format (e.g. 2026-01). Defaults to current month if not provided.

name: get_dashboard_metrics
title: Get dashboard metrics
